item.title: [ESCALATING] Central Bank Supply-Side Policy Recalibration & Trade Dynamics — Fed releases January 27-28 FOMC minutes February 18, adding eighth central bank communication to coordination sequence
item.description:
The Federal Reserve released minutes from the January 27-28 Federal Open Market Committee meeting on February 18, extending the documented central bank communication sequence to eight releases within the February 18-March 26 coordination window. The minutes disclosure occurred four days before the Fed's February 23 reputation risk removal proposal and six days before the February 24 discount rate minutes release.
The January 27-28 FOMC minutes represent the primary monetary policy deliberation ...
